correctness.rationale: For F=x³z−xz³−H, F_x=−z³ and at P∞ the F_z derivative is nonzero; all other lines split into x=ay+bz or y=tz and latter meet P∞ with order one. Polynomial identity −F|line−Q²=A y z³−B z⁴, exactly verified by executable polynomial ring arithmetic, yields 9 separable a roots and 3 separable b roots each. Q=(y−uz)²−dz² and uniqueness of tangents yield 55 versus 28 distinct contact points and the relative branch divisor d=0.
